name: Town Centre (Plaza Bolivar)
tagline: Colourful main square and heart of town
description: The central plaza around Bolivar square, ringed by colourful balconied houses, restaurants and the church. This is the social hub with the most cafes, trout eateries and craft shops, busy with weekend visitors but compact and easy to explore on foot.
bestFor: First-time visitors wanting cafes, restaurants and the classic plaza vibe

name: Calle Real
tagline: Iconic craft street up to viewpoint
description: The famous pedestrian street of brightly painted houses climbing north from the plaza to the Mirador viewpoint stairs. Lined with artisan stalls, coffee shops and souvenir stores, it is the most touristic strip but central and full of local colour and character.
bestFor: Travellers wanting cafes, crafts and easy walks to viewpoints

name: Outskirts toward Cocora
tagline: Rural lanes near the palm valley
description: The quieter rural fringes on the northeastern road toward Cocora Valley, with fincas, guesthouses and coffee farms among green hills. Calm and scenic with cooler air and nature at hand, though you need jeeps or a walk to reach town services.
bestFor: Nature lovers and remote workers wanting quiet fincas and green views
